text: There are two birds. Both are red. Describe the birds in one sentence.
The two birds are red.
Before, there were two red birds. Now one bird is left. Describe its color.
The bird is red.
Find and fix one word.
The three rabbits are white.
There is one green frog. Describe the frog in one sentence.
The frog is green.
There are three rabbits. All are black. Describe all three rabbits in one sentence.
The three rabbits are black.
There are two birds. Both are blue. Describe both birds in one sentence.
The two birds are blue.
The title is A Bird in the Rain. What do you think the poem is about?
I think this poem is about a bird.
Now there are two poems. The titles are A Bird in the Rain and A Dog in the Snow. What do you think both poems are about?
I think these poems are about animals.
Find and fix one word.
I think this poem is about a tree.
The title is A Fish in the Lake. What do you think this poem is about?
I think this poem is about a fish.
The titles are A Rabbit at Dawn and A Bird at Night. What do you think both poems are about?
I think these poems are about animals.
The title is A Tree in the Wind. What do you think this poem is about?
I think this poem is about a tree.
Say tree, see, and sun. Which word rhymes with tree?
Tree rhymes with see.
Before, the words were tree and see. Now compare tree and sun. How do the ending sounds compare?
Tree and sun sound different.
Say sky, high, and see. Find and fix one word in the sentence.
Sky rhymes with high.
Say sun, fun, and tree. Which word rhymes with sun?
Sun rhymes with fun.
Say dark and tree. How do the ending sounds compare?
The ending sounds are different.
Say black, high, and back. Which word rhymes with black?
Black rhymes with back.
Ava wrote A Green Leaf. Ben reads it aloud. Who is the author?
Ava is the author.
Ava wrote the poem, and Ben reads it aloud. Now talk about Ben. Is he the author?
Ben is not the author.
Leo wrote the poem, and Mia reads it aloud. Find and fix one word.
Leo is the author.
Mia wrote The Small Seed and Sam reads it aloud, so who is the author?
Mia is the author.
Mia wrote the poem and Sam reads it aloud, so can you say in a full sentence if Sam is the author?
Sam is not the author.
Kim wrote A Red Leaf. Tom reads it aloud. Who is the author?
Kim is the author.
In the garden, you see one black rabbit. Tell me what is there.
There is a black rabbit.
Before, there was one black rabbit. Now another black rabbit comes. Tell me what is there.
There are two black rabbits.
Find and fix one word.
There is a green lizard.
In the garden, you see one red bird. Tell me what is there.
There is a red bird.
In the garden, you see three white rabbits. Tell me what is there.
There are three white rabbits.
In the garden, you see two green lizards. Tell me what is there.
There are two green lizards.
